description.ja: • 「機動戦士ガンダム UC episode 4」にも登場のザク・マリナーがZZ版で登場。
description.en: • Zaku Mariner, who also appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam UC episode 4", appears in the ZZ version.

description.ja: • 水中で曳航してもらうためのマグネット・ハーケンが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a magnetic harken for towing underwater.

description.ja: • 曳航シーンも付属のリードで再現可能。
description.en: • The towing scene can also be recreated with the included leash.

description.ja: • 頭部アンテナは一般機用のほか指揮官機用も付属。
description.en: • Head antennas are included for both general aircraft and commander aircraft.

description.ja: • 胸部パーツは２種。プラモオリジナルのザクタイプのハッチが付属。
description.en: • There are 2 types of chest parts. A plastic model original Zaku type hatch is included.

description.ja: 成形品×5、リード線×１、ホイルシール×1、マーキングシール×1、組立説明書×1
description.en: Molded product x 5, lead wire x 1, foil seal x 1, marking seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
